positiveEvidenceObserved.subject: Candidate stability
positiveEvidenceObserved.detail: Automated and browser evidence bind to the same current sourceTreeSha256 and browser cleanup completed successfully.

positiveEvidenceObserved.subject: Browser journey coverage
positiveEvidenceObserved.detail: The walkthrough records successful local generation, workspace, invitation, ownership, private-download, restart and viewport journeys. These observations do not override unresolved acceptance rows or the manual visual approval requirement.

limitations: This review does not alter the current M3 acceptance record, acceptance register or gate status.
This review does not provide commercial, release, production or paid-provider approval.
